general.name: GPSSA Pension & Social Security
general.description: Mandatory pension and social security for UAE and GCC national employees, administered by the General Pension and Social Security Authority. Expatriates are not covered.

eligibility.notes: UAE nationals (and GCC nationals under the unified system) in the private sector. Rates below are the Federal Decree-Law No. 57 of 2023 regime for members first registered on/after 31 Oct 2023. Members registered earlier remain on the pre-2023 regime: employee 5%, employer 12.5% (+ 2.5% government).

caps.name: Maximum contribution account salary (private sector, new members)

calculationRules.name: Contribution Account Salary
calculationRules.description: Contribution is levied on basic wage plus contractual fixed allowances, subject to a floor of AED 1,000 and a ceiling of AED 100,000 for new private-sector members.

reporting.dueDate: By the 15th of the following month

validations.name: Nationals only
validations.errorMessage: GPSSA applies only to UAE and GCC national employees

validations.name: Contribution salary ceiling
validations.errorMessage: Contribution account salary exceeds the AED 100,000 ceiling
